decisions.reason: As a full facial care line with its own dedicated page in both years, the aloe vera range carries the firm's largest investment and most visible public commitment, so management will persist with it and attribute any weak sales to a market still building up.

The hyaluronic serum has stayed on the website for two years and fits the facial care direction the firm has announced, so management will justify keeping it despite its lower visibility and modest investment.

The cleansing oil was launched only in 2024, likely as the follow-up to the dropped cleansing milk, so management will treat weak early results as a temporary launch effect and give it more time to justify the replacement decision.
